question: Which institution was formed on 2 April 1990?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)** was established on **2 April 1990**.
 
• SIDBI is the principal financial institution for the promotion, financing, and development of the **Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSME)** sector in India.
 
• It is headquartered in **Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• SIDBI provides various types of financial assistance including **loans, equity, and grant support** to MSMEs.
 
• It also plays a significant role in supporting the **development of entrepreneurship** and the **creation of employment opportunities** in the MSME sector.
 
• SIDBI also coordinates the functions of institutions engaged in similar activities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Housing Bank (NHB)**__

 __
 
• The **National Housing Bank (NHB)** was established in **1988** under the National Housing Bank Act, 1987.
 
• The NHB is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** and is the apex institution for housing finance in India.
 
• Its primary objective is to promote housing finance institutions and provide financial and other support to such institutions.
 
 
 
• **Export-Import Bank of India (EXIM Bank)**__
 __
 
• The **Export-Import Bank of India (EXIM Bank)** was established in **1982** under the Export-Import Bank of India Act, 1981.
 
• EXIM Bank is the principal financial institution in India for coordinating the working of institutions engaged in financing the import and export of goods and services.
 
• It provides financial assistance to exporters and importers and functions as the principal financial institution for coordinating the working of other institutions engaged in financing export and import.
 
 
 
• **Industrial Reconstruction Bank of India (IRBI)**__
 
 
• The **Industrial Reconstruction Bank of India (IRBI)** was established in **1985** to provide financial assistance for the reconstruction and rehabilitation of industrial units.
 
• In 1997, IRBI was reconstituted as the **Industrial Investment Bank of India (IIBI)**.
 
• IRBI played a crucial role in reviving sick industrial units and promoting industrial development in India.
